name: phone-sms
description: Read and send SMS from Claude Code through your own Android phone, over KDE Connect on your local network.

plugins.name: phone-sms
plugins.description: MCP server with four tools (list_threads, read_thread, find_contact, send_sms) over the local KDE Connect daemon. Needs Linux, KDE Connect paired with an Android phone, and uv. Sends only after you approve recipient and text.
